image.alt: Alex performing a back massage, pressing firmly into the client's back while the client lies on a gray towel-covered massage table.

heading: Body treatments
body: I offer a menu of body treatments designed to help you relax and revive your skin, your body and your wellbeing.
From full-body exfoliation to targeted sports massage, each treatment is tailored to you and your needs.
If you're feeling sluggish, stressed or you need to recover after intense exercise - this to your space to pause and reset.

image.alt: Alex performing a foot massage, with hands gently manipulating the client's foot.

heading: Hands and feet
body: Your hands and feet work hard every day, and they deserve attention and care.
I offer classic and gel manicures and pedicures with a focus on nail health, skin smoothing and perfectly neat finishes. Cuticle care, shaping, and massage are all included.

I also offer reflexology sessions, using this ancient process to tap into your body's energy and restore balance. Whether it's regular upkeep or a special occasion treatment, your hands and feet leave our salon looking and feeling their best.

image.alt: Alex Ray applying a white facial treatment mask with a brush to a client who is lying down with a white head wrap.

heading: Around the eyes
body: I offer brow shaping, tinting and lash lifts to enhance your eyes and add natural-looking definition.
It's ideal if you want to feel more polished with less makeup, and every treatment is tailored to your features, so the result feels effortless and flattering.

treatments.name: Eyelash Tint & Eyebrow Shape and Tint

image.alt: Alex applying warm leg wax to a client using a professional waxing applicator tool.

heading: Waxing
body: My waxing treatments are designed to leave your skin smooth, soft, and cared for, so you can feel confident and comfortable.
From precise brow shaping to full-body waxing, each treatment is tailored to your needs, whether it's everyday upkeep or special occasion preparation.

image.alt: Alex performing a facial treatment on a smiling client. The client wears a white flanel on her forehead.

heading: Facials
body: From glow-boosting exfoliation to calming, nourishing treatments, my facials are designed to leave you looking radiant and feeling refreshed.
Whether you want to unwind with a relaxing massage or target specific skin concerns, each treatment is customised to you.

treatments.name: Face Massage
description: Relaxing face massage with vitamin oil boosts collagen, reduces fatigue, and increases circulation.
Finish with a cooling skin gym ice globe to leave you feeling fresh.

treatments.name: Glycolic Facial Peel
description: This resurfacing facial combines glycolic acid, salicylic acid and pomegranate enzyme for a healthier, smoother and brighter complexion.
Perfect for anti-aging, as it improves pigmentation and reduces wrinkles and also ideal for treating acne prone skin and scaring.

treatments.name: Relaxing Facial
description: This relaxing treatment is customised to your skin's needs.
Including a double cleanse, exfoliation, neck/shoulder and facial massage, mask, serum and moisturiser, with a hand/arm or scalp massage added on for complete relaxation.

treatments.name: Microdermabrasion
description: This gentle facial is designed to give your skin a perfect glow!

The treatment uses a diamond-studded tip with suction to give a deep exfoliation that lifts away dead skin cells, leaving your skin brighter, softer and more plump, refining the pores as well as reducing fine lines and wrinkles.
Results are noticeable after one treatment, but a course of treatments is recommended and will enhance these results.
